h1: What lead paint containment rules apply when renovating an older Newton home?
title: Massachusetts Lead-Safe Renovation Rules for Older Newton Homes
description: Learn when paid renovation work in pre-1978 housing must be performed by a licensed lead-safe renovation contractor.
short_answer: Massachusetts requires lead-safe renovation work by a licensed lead-safe renovation contractor when paid work in a pre-1978 home disturbs more than 6 square feet of painted surface per room indoors or more than 20 square feet outdoors. A lead-safe renovation project is different from a deleading project. Confirm which rules apply before disturbing painted surfaces.

sections.heading: When the lead-safe renovation rule applies

facts.text: Massachusetts applies its lead-safe renovation requirements to paid work in pre-1978 housing when more than 6 square feet of painted surface per room is disturbed indoors or more than 20 square feet is disturbed outdoors.
Massachusetts distinguishes renovation work from work intended to abate lead hazards or obtain a Letter of Compliance.

qa.q: Does every repair in a pre-1978 home require a deleading project?
qa.a: No. Massachusetts distinguishes lead-safe renovation work from deleading. The applicable requirement depends on the work's purpose and the amount of painted surface disturbed.
